text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking up some books for research
purposes
at the library, when...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I should be making my target time, but
I'm only
getting slower.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My baseline endurance has improved, so
just
what else is missing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Graaass! Heeelp meee!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Urara?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you gave me a shock. But try to
keep your
voice down here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Although, it's quite the surprise to see
you in the
library, of all places.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm... You see, I had a quiz the
other day,
and it didn't go so well.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I tried super-duper hard, but it came
back
covered in red ink. I have to take it
all over again.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And if I fail that one, it's extra classes
for me...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I won't have any time to train if this
keeps up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Gosh, that is quite the conundrum.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So... I was thinking you could help me
study!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You train super-duper hard, but you
always find
the time to study. It's
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I want to be just like you—good at running and studying!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Urara...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's awfully comforting to hear such
words of
praise, considering how much
of a hard worker
you are.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Hehe, that makes me
happy!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now, shall we get studying? Let's
start by
going over what your quiz was
about.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay, thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Argh! I left my pens and pencils
behind! I'll go
back for them, so hold on
tight!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no need to rush. Please, take
your
time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I suppose this calls for a little adjusting to my training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is doing a good job
balancing her
time training and studying,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks a little worn down. I decide to
check in
on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks a little worn down. I decide to
check in
on her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there. I suppose you heard me
thinking
aloud.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It could be just as you say. I
haven't done
anything to relax as of late.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't said anything, I might not
have
noticed. Perhaps that's what is
holding me back
from improving...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that. I was merely
talking to
myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should take the same advice I
gave
Urara. I shouldn't rush...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Did you happen to hear me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say that my condition has
changed.
Although...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I must take care to make sure I'm not
inviting
concern from those around me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm not spreading myself too thin, so
please don't
worry.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I'll take your words to heart. It's
quite
troubling to me if that's how I look.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. It's helped
me gather
my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Grass! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Urara. That was fast.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I don't hurry, that means less
time with
you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I don't like studying that much... But if
you're
around, I know I'll have tons of
fun.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It just so happens that my
afternoon has
freed up for today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So why don't we take it easy and study
at a slow,
leisurely pace! ♪
